title: Realized kurtosis as an incremental HAR-RV predictor
summary: Local 5-minute panels cover only 2026 year-to-date and produce fewer than 252 OOS forecasts per market. Treat as a pipeline feasibility pilot, not evidence for or against realized kurtosis.

forecast_timing.features: RV/RK at date t computed from local 5-minute bars through that day's close
forecast_timing.target: average RV over t+1 through t+5
forecast_timing.oos_fit: expanding OLS; each forecast uses only rows strictly before the forecast row
forecast_timing.lookahead: CLEAN for the implemented forecast target; no same-day target data enters predictors

data.taiwan_proxy_note: 0050.TW is used as a Taiwan index ETF proxy; no long TAIEX 5-minute panel was found locally.
data.sample_limitation: 2026 year-to-date only; below the project's 252-day minimum OOS threshold.

models.estimator: log-linear OLS with expanding window and lognormal bias correction
models.loss: Patton QLIKE on 5-day average realized variance

literature_context.title: Corsi (2009), A Simple Approximate Long-Memory Model of Realized Volatility
literature_context.use: HAR-RV baseline and daily/weekly/monthly realized-volatility components.

literature_context.title: Mei et al. (2017), Forecasting stock market volatility: Do realized skewness and kurtosis help?
literature_context.use: Motivates testing realized skewness/kurtosis as HAR-RV extensions; reports mixed horizon-specific evidence.

literature_context.title: Bonato et al. (2022), Forecasting realized volatility of international REITs
literature_context.use: Documents cases where realized higher moments improve HAR-RV forecasts across horizons.

next_steps: Acquire or build a multi-year SPY and TAIEX/TAIFEX 5-minute panel before drawing a publication-grade conclusion.
Add realized skewness and jump controls in a matched horse race once the long panel exists.
Keep the target as future RV t+1:t+5; do not compare HAR-RV forecasts against close-to-close r^2 without Hansen-Lunde adjustment.
